# Oliver Travel Trailers

> Oliver Travel Trailers manufactures luxury fiberglass travel trailers built with innovative design, four-season capability, and off-grid power systems.

Oliver Travel Trailers is a premium RV manufacturer based in Hohenwald, Tennessee, specializing in high-quality fiberglass campers. The company emphasizes craftsmanship, durability, and customer experience across its product lineup.

## Key Topics

- Legacy Elite
- Legacy Elite II
- Fiberglass construction
- Four-season camping
- Solar panels & lithium batteries
- Luxury travel trailers
- Off-grid power systems
- Double hull design
- Virtual tours
- Factory tours
- Warranty coverage
- Dealer locator
- Travel trailer financing
- Hohenwald, Tennessee
- Innovative design
